_decisions_locked_2026-05-19: Q-AMENPRO1 RESOLVED — half-season amenity is prorated 0.50× of annual.
Within residents (people who live at WMCA), owners and renters price identically (both map to 'resident' multiplier 0.75).

Owners always get a discount — non-resident-owners (own a WMCA condo but don't live there) get a discount vs. pure non-residents. Schema expanded from 2 to 3 buckets: resident, non_resident_owner, non_resident.
Non-resident-owner discount magnitude is intentionally Modeler-driven — board will project revenue at various values via the Scenario Modeler and lock the rate before FY27. Placeholder: 0.85.
_meta._rounding_implementation_note: JavaScript's Math.round is half-away-from-zero, not half-to-even. Use a banker's-rounding helper: `Math.round((x % 1 === 0.5 && Math.floor(x) % 2 === 0) ? Math.floor(x) : x)` for the .5 case, or use a decimal library (e.g., decimal.js with ROUND_HALF_EVEN). Apply at the FINAL total step only — don't round intermediate base/amenity values.
